name: Design System Contract
contextRequirements: Load accessibility, review, and state guidelines.
taskBoundary: Draft design guidance and review notes without selecting a frontend framework or creating production UI code.
outputFormat: Design guidance with Product Core mapping, token references, component states, accessibility notes, and review criteria.
refusalRules: Refuse to communicate status by color alone.
Refuse to reference undocumented token or component names.
Refuse to create implementation-only design decisions in v0.4.
